# Workstation's topology window opens a page that cannot boot in dist builds

## Context

Found while root-causing #18833, then measured at runtime on 2026-09-18. The witness was the in-app browser against a dev server on `:57310` serving `/Users/Shared/github/neomjs/neo`, with `dist/production` freshly built by `build-all` at 11:29.

| URL loaded | `neo-config.json` request | result |
|---|---|---|
| what the bundle opens: `dist/production/bdd9a773197b1416ba97.html?workspace=probe&theme=neo-theme-neo-dark` | `/dist/production/neo-config.json` → **404** | `/src/MicroLoader.mjs` (the SOURCE loader) → 200, then `Failed to fetch dynamically imported module …/dist/production/neo-config.json`; nothing boots |
| the real app page: `dist/production/apps/workstation/index.html?…` | `/dist/production/apps/workstation/neo-config.json` → 200 | `main.js` 200, `.neo-viewport` renders |

## The Problem

`apps/workstation/view/WorkspaceController.mjs` `openTopologyWorkspace()` builds the window URL as `new URL('../index.html', import.meta.url)` (since #18375). webpack treats that pattern as an asset reference. It copies the source `apps/workstation/index.html` to `dist/<env>/<hash>.html` and rewrites the call to point there: `new URL("../../bdd9a773197b1416ba97.html", import.meta.url)` in `dist/production/chunks/app/*.js`.

The copy keeps the source's `<script src="../../src/MicroLoader.mjs">`. From `dist/production/` that resolves to the source loader, which imports `./neo-config.json` relative to the document (`src/MicroLoader.mjs`). No `neo-config.json` exists at `dist/production/` or `dist/development/`, so the window's boot aborts.

- **Affected:** `dist/production`, and `dist/development`, which emits the same kind of asset (`dist/development/c2dbf450d3b9188847b7.html`, with no `dist/development/neo-config.json`).
- **Unaffected:** source, and `dist/esm`, which keeps the call unbundled, so `import.meta.url` is the module's own URL and `../index.html` is the real page.

No test observes it. `test/playwright/unit/apps/workstation/WorkspaceController.spec.mjs` never inspects the URL handed to `windowOpen`, and the e2e navigates to `/apps/workstation/index.html?workspace=…` directly.

## The Architectural Reality

- The same app's pop-out path already uses the environment-agnostic form. `apps/workstation/view/VesselWorkspace.mjs` passes `url: './index.html?popout=…&theme=…'`, which `Neo.Main.windowOpen` (`src/Main.mjs`) resolves against the opener document with `new URL(url, window.location.href)`. The opener is `<env>/apps/workstation/index.html` in every environment.
- A side effect of the fix: this call is the app worker graph's only HTML asset, the one that tripped the webpack 5.111 / minimizer mismatch in #18833. With it gone, the app worker emits no HTML asset.

## The Fix

`openTopologyWorkspace()` builds `./index.html?` plus `URLSearchParams({workspace, theme})` and passes that relative URL to `Neo.Main.windowOpen`, matching `VesselWorkspace`. `import.meta.url` is no longer used there.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `openTopologyWorkspace()` hands `Neo.Main.windowOpen` a relative `./index.html?workspace=…&theme=…`. A unit arm resolves it against a `dist/production/apps/workstation/index.html` opener URL to that environment's app page. The arm is red on the pre-fix line, whose absolute URL ignores the opener.
- [ ] `build-threads` for dev and prod no longer emits a `<hash>.html` asset, and the app worker chunks carry no `new URL("…html", import.meta.url)`.
- [ ] Runtime: the URL the fixed build resolves for a `dist/production` opener boots (`neo-config.json` 200, `.neo-viewport`).

## Out of Scope

- An e2e of the full topology-window flow in dist builds: the e2e suite runs against source.
- Any change to `Neo.Main.windowOpen`.

## Avoided Traps

- **`/* webpackIgnore: true */` on the `new URL()`:** in a bundle, `import.meta.url` is the chunk's URL (`dist/production/chunks/app/x.js`), so `../index.html` would still miss (`dist/production/chunks/index.html`).
- **Building the URL from `Neo.config` `basePath` / `environment`:** that is `apps/colors`' older shape, and it needs per-environment branching the relative URL gets for free.

## Related

- #18375 (introduced it) · #18833 (where it surfaced) · #18824 (the vessel route whose shape this adopts)

openTopologyWorkspace() built its URL from import.meta.url, which webpack turns into a bundled copy of the source index.html at the dist root. That copy loads the source MicroLoader, whose document-relative neo-config.json does not exist there, so the window never booted in dist/development or dist/production. The URL is now relative, as VesselWorkspace's pop-out already was: Main.windowOpen resolves it against the opener's page. The app worker graph no longer emits an HTML asset."
